name: Your REST API
description: Connects the HTTP client to your own server: the base URL comes from .env through the xcconfig, and the app shows a configuration message until it is set.

credentialsNeeded.description: Base URL of your API, for example https://api.example.com/v1

cost.note: The client is free; hosting your API is billed by your provider

usage: Create the client once at the composition root with `APIConfiguration.makeClient()`, which returns nil until API_BASE_URL is set in .env (show `APINotConfiguredView` in that case, or a `StubAPIClient` with sample data). Pass it down as `any APIClient`. Never put server secrets in the app; authenticate users and let the server hold its keys.
statusNote: Not yet built on a Mac; run `ios-agent-mcp capabilities verify rest-api-client` on a Mac with Xcode.
